content.value_statement: Internal updates can become inconsistent when teams use different formats. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code draft concise updates, newsletters, and FAQs.
actual_capabilities: Selects a communication format from the user request.
Drafts 3P updates with Progress, Plans, and Problems sections.
Creates company newsletter drafts with concise grouped bullets.
Turns repeated employee questions into short FAQ answers.
Asks for audience, purpose, tone, and format for custom messages.
Encourages links to authoritative internal sources when available.
limitations: Does not include scripts, integrations, or automatic connector setup.
Cannot access Slack, email, calendars, or documents without granted access.
Does not replace legal, HR, security, or executive approval.
Requires user review before broad company distribution.

use_cases.title: Weekly Team Update
use_cases.description: Create a short 3P update for leadership review.

use_cases.title: Company Newsletter
use_cases.description: Summarize major announcements, milestones, and leadership messages for employees.

use_cases.title: Employee FAQ
use_cases.description: Answer repeated employee questions with clear source-backed language.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a 3P Update
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request with notes already provided.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a 3P update for the Platform team covering this week. Use these notes: [paste notes].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Newsletter
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a broad company update.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a company newsletter for the past two weeks. Group items by theme and include my links: [paste announcements and links].

prompt_templates.title: Build an FAQ
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request based on employee questions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these employee questions into an internal FAQ. Keep each answer short and mark uncertain items for review: [paste questions].

prompt_templates.title: Synthesize Multiple Sources
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request using several authorized inputs.
prompt_templates.prompt: Draft a leadership update from these source notes. Prioritize company-wide impact, metrics, risks, and decisions needed: [paste source summaries].

output_examples.input: A team lead needs a weekly 3P update for executives.
output_examples.output:
Platform Team, June 22 to June 28
Progress: Shipped the onboarding checklist and reduced setup time by 18%.
Plans: Finish rollout monitoring and prepare the analytics review.
Problems: Two enterprise requests remain blocked on data export approval.

output_examples.input: Employees are asking repeated questions about a new office policy.
output_examples.output:
Question: When does the new office policy begin?
Answer: The policy begins on July 8. Employees should review the official announcement before making schedule changes.

output_examples.input: A communications manager needs a company newsletter section.
output_examples.output:
Company Announcements
- We completed quarterly planning and published team priorities.
- We welcomed the new customer success leader this week.
- We shared the updated launch calendar for the next release.

best_practices: Provide source notes, dates, audience, and channel before requesting a draft.
Review drafts for confidentiality, accuracy, approvals, names, metrics, and links.
Use official announcements, documents, or executive messages as source material.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the assistant to infer confidential strategy from incomplete context.
Do not publish drafts without checking facts, dates, permissions, and links.
Do not include team-only details in company-wide messages unless they affect most employees.

faq.question: What communication formats does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports 3P updates, company newsletters, FAQ answers, status reports, leadership updates, project updates, and incident reports.

faq.question: Does it connect to company tools by itself?
faq.answer: No. It only suggests using sources when the user has granted access or provided content.

faq.question: Can it write for executives and employees?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes formats for leadership updates, broad newsletters, and employee FAQ responses.

faq.question: How should sensitive information be handled?
faq.answer: Users should limit source access, remove confidential details, and review each draft before sharing.

faq.question: Does the skill enforce a strict format?
faq.answer: It enforces a strict 3P structure and gives flexible guidance for newsletters, FAQs, and custom messages.

faq.question: Does it run commands or scripts?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed skill is markdown guidance and does not contain executable scripts.
